subtitle: Who uses this Toskar, and what each person may do.
adminsOnly: Only Admins and the Owner manage people.
ownerNoSignIn: Uses this computer; no sign-in for other devices yet
byProxy: Signs in through your sign-in service as {{name}}
private: Each person's chats, memories, files, and automations are private to them, the Owner's too. Models, tools, knowledge, and profiles are shared.

add.title: Add a person
add.body: They get a one-time link to choose a username and password.
add.name: Name

roleHint.admin: Admins manage models, tools, computers, and people other than Admins and the Owner.
roleHint.member: Members use Toskar: their own chats, memories, files, and automations.

link.invite: Send {{name}} this link to choose a username and password:
link.reset: Send {{name}} this link to choose a new password:
link.lanOff: Only this computer can open it until local network access is on.
link.lanOffAction: Turn it on in API Access

invite.goneBody: It expired or was already used. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
invite.title: Welcome, {{name}}
invite.body: Choose a username and password to sign in to this Toskar.
invite.resetBody: Choose a new password. Other devices signed in as you will be signed out.
invite.usernameHint: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes, or underscores.

signIn.title: Sign in to Toskar
signIn.body: This Toskar is shared. Sign in with the username and password you chose from your invitation.
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an Admin or the Owner for a new password link.

provider.failed: Signing in with {{name}} didn't work. Try again.
provider.refused: Your account at {{name}} doesn't give you a role on this Toskar. Ask its Owner to add you to a group that does.
provider.disabled: Your account on this Toskar is turned off. Ask its Owner.
provider.unavailable: Signing in with another service isn't available right now.

changePassword.title: Choose your own password, {{name}}
changePassword.body: The password you were given was set by an Admin. Choose one only you know before you go on.

account.label: Your account
account.signedInByProxy: Signed in as {{name}} by your sign-in service, {{role}}. Sign out there.

pins.title: Profiles they use
pins.body: Keep Members or Visitors to one or more profiles, such as an assistant with topic controls. They can't pick another. Admins and the Owner always have every profile.
pins.noneTicked: With none ticked, they use any profile.

capabilities.title: What people may use
capabilities.body: Turn things on or off for each role. Someone's own Allow or Block, below, comes before their role's.
capabilities.owner: The Owner always has everything. Only the Owner changes what Admins may use.

hints.files: Attach documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, and code
hints.pictures_in: Send pictures and videos to look at
hints.make_video: Make clips; ties up the graphics card
hints.voice: Speak messages and hear answers read aloud
hints.web: Web lookup, pages, places, and maps
hints.knowledge_add: Add, change, and remove Knowledge sources
hints.changing_tools: Commands, file writes, and MCP and plugin actions
hints.choose_model: Pick a model by hand; otherwise Auto
hints.remote_access: Use paired devices away from home
